title: Envelope Proof
note: Either a W3C Data Integrity Proof or a detached JWS; `cryptosuite` is absent for the JWS form. `proof_purpose` is always "assertionMethod". `proof_value` is a multibase base58btc signature over the canonical envelope with proofValue itself set to the empty string — a signature cannot cover itself, and emptying rather than removing the member is the convention the reference implementation pins.
book_ref: APH Spec: §7.1.11 EnvelopeProof, §8.2 Proof block formats
